items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I knew him, naturally, as much as I knew about him. I knew about Chick and both, because I'd been hearing about them for years.

ctx.x: And you said you wanted to stay with Fletcher.

Yeah. Yeah, after doing this thing we had a -- I think it was a New Year's Eve thing. We did it with Fletcher, and the band went pretty good, and where I was lucky and happy afterwards for doing this recording, and I didn't have the music, and I memorized it, and everything went well.

Well after that we had a couple of days, or one day, in the Savoy. Well for years, before -- even before I met Fletcher, or joined him, he and Chick Webb (laughs) had been battling, you know, and music, you know, who's the best, who's greatest, and when the people would pack the place to see it. So while I was with him he's saying we had a -- oh, strenuous rehearsal. He said well I'm going to play against that little guy again. He said this time I must -- I gotta get -- I gotta get him.
